packages.astropy: >=6.0; used for fits.io (FITS reading) and astropy.wcs
packages.scipy: >=1.13; used for scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates and scipy.spatial (Delaunay, Voronoi)

notes: The frozen implementation depends only on numpy, matplotlib, astropy, scipy. No GPU acceleration, no MPI, no threading.
Every frozen run produces byte-exact reproducible outputs when executed on the same OS and Python version.
Matplotlib is used only for plotting; it is not on the computational critical path.
astropy is used only for FITS reading (WEAK-LENSING-OBSERVATION-001).
scipy is used for map_coordinates (resampling) and spatial algorithms (Delaunay, Voronoi).
